description: Accidental Finish recovery with aligned quiet Undo (REQ-014; C38, C39, C60; R124, R130, R141, R145; P04) delivered through TimedResultLog's completion action (src/ui/refinements/timed-result-log.tsx, recipe .clr-timed-undo in src/ui/refinements/presentation.css), the shared TimedWorkoutActions lead control (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx) and the route consumer LadderBlock (src/ui/ladder-block.tsx) over TASK-032's durable ladder attempt (usePersistedLadder: undoFinish, and markRecorded fed by the shell's BlockCompletionProvider onBlockRecorded) on the real /workout route and the ladder end log (JOURNEY-014): after an athlete's Finish the quiet Undo finish · Resume ladder sits below Complete / Incomplete and before Rounds completed, its visible text (a Range over its text node) starting at the dynamic rounds-completed count's left edge with no inherited quiet-button inset, at the shared control height, with no confirmation; Undo returns the same attempt - a running clock on from the same start (the time spent finished counts, none granted), a paused one paused again at the same moment, live progress from the log's rounds, the log's entries kept and the answer back to before Finish - within the original cap, withdrawn the moment undoing would resume at or past that cap, kept through a reload and a failed save, and ended at once and durably by a successful save (even when a reload cannot read the row back); Finish again and save writes exactly one row per ladder with the truthful highest_rung; Finish and Undo never complete or leave the workout; For Time's Finish offers no Undo and no older For Time answer becomes the ladder's. Two differently shaped ladders (twelve rungs of kettlebell swing 3-36 reps with a fixed row under one 09:00 cap; four rungs of plank 5-20 sec under a 15:00 cap, TASK-013's fixture), a legacy direct mount and the accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=ladder-4 and ?state=ladder-12 (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) drawing the actual LadderBlock, at 320 and 390, touch and keyboard, reduced motion, axe with no exception. Every declared case must execute and pass; the earlier cases in the same file whose names carry 'resume' or 'cap' (TASK-006, TASK-011, TASK-013) are selected by the pattern and must pass too, but are not declared here.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-014 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/timed-workout-flow.test.tsx --testNamePattern "undo|resume|cap" --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo while running returns the same attempt within its original cap: the time spent finished counts and none is granted, the checked progress and the log’s entries come back, the answer returns to before Finish, and nothing completes the workout (AC-C38-01)

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-C38-01 undo while paused pauses the same attempt again at the same moment with its progress; resumed, finished again and saved, each of two differently shaped attempts writes exactly one row with the truthful highest round completed

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo is withdrawn the moment it would resume at the original cap, unprompted and for good, and the cap itself is never undone: the finished time, the log and its correction stay and are saved

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo survives close and reopen and a failed save with its draft kept, and a successful save ends it at once and durably, even when a reopen cannot read the saved row back

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-01 the quiet undo sits below Complete and Incomplete and before Rounds completed, left-aligned with no inherited inset, the existing small quiet button at the shared control height, reached by Tab and taking no confirmation (AC-C39-01, AC-C60-01, AC-R014-02)

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > JOURNEY-014 the accepted gallery’s four- and twelve-round states draw the route’s own quiet undo: Finish, then Undo finish brings the same attempt back with its checked rounds, and its original cap withdraws it, over memory only

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 no stale completion survives an undo: an older build’s For Time answer stored beside an adopted clock never becomes the attempt’s answer, and For Time’s own Finish offers no undo
